answers.otherText:
Lead decision, TJ may reverse: adopt the [startup/custody contract](/TJS/issues/TJS-2504#document-startup-custody-contract), exact revision `9b0fdb87-ab50-44fe-ad72-dec1098593bf`, with the ordering and trust-source clarifications below. This records the finite source continuation required by [the conductor direction](/TJS/issues/TJS-2504#comment-fbb33f76-9c8a-49ee-a332-4749be119d9c). The historical administrator question is not a prerequisite for this source work.

**Finite source continuation.** P2P/Mining `3730ad68-e373-4c8a-84df-2e11327b86a5` remains the sole writer. From clean `94666d8063cb4aadd861c030ed3b9461a6ed77be`, use one implementation pass and one correction pass, at most 120 minutes from the first production edit, on the existing branch under `vanguard/network/` only. Implement the connected task-only custodian/constructor through the existing bootstrap, InstalledIngress, RootEntry, capability and record journals. Reuse existing code before adding the proposed files. Refreeze the affected source, installer, entry/unit/record inventory and transitive installation bindings. This is the complete source-scope decision; do not seek another ordinary repair authorization. Current runtime protections still apply, and this response changes no hold or execution-stage state.

**Selected startup order.** Keep the proposed fixed, no-argument `/usr/bin/python3 -I -B /opt/meownero/TJS-2504/helper/profile-custodian.py` and the existing fixed root-helper entry. The new operator install/start prefix must be explicit and separately reviewable. Independently install and verify the immutable closure before RootEntry can validate it. Change record 1 to verification of those exact existing objects; do not reinstall or overwrite them. Also resolve the accounting dependency before starting the custodian: any parent/control units needed by the startup prefix must already exist under its exact operator contract. If creation moves into that prefix, corresponding later records verify those same units rather than create them again. Freeze every affected caller and command. Charge installation, authentication, custodian, retained state and recovery/observer work to the existing allocations; the prefix has no unaccounted bootstrap interval. Do not silently preserve the old packet's identity after changing it.

**Independent authority.** The existing outside operator owns the protected initial launch and its task/attempt/source/index/boot/unit/identity/deadline receipt. The immutable constructor must obtain its expectations through that independently authorized startup channel, distinct from the ingress it verifies, and bind them to actual kernel sender/receiver PID/start and manager invocation observations. Manager membership, root UID, a local index/hash, caller-sealed descriptors or received claims cannot issue first-start authority. Keep the existing unnamed seqpacket/SCM_RIGHTS transport and its separate root authority/context/index versus lifecycle authority/context/namespace descriptor roles. Implement the operator-to-constructor path in the source fixture; directly supplying the old test trust dictionary does not satisfy this continuation. Live authentication, syscall/D-Bus/storage and other unsupplied primitives remain explicit refusing boundaries. Registries stay empty and bootstrap/capabilities null until their separate qualification requirements are met.

**Survival and acceptance.** Freeze the prefix plus every conditional branch of the current 55-record/eight-unit itinerary, including the record changes above. Fresh processes must traverse entry -> constructor -> ingress -> installed-layout guard -> journal -> injected effect -> durable completion. Include wrong issuer/source/index/unit/boot/PID/start, same-byte replacement FDs, vanished custodian, concurrent replay, actual disposable child crash, failed fsync/ENOSPC, rollback ambiguity, expired original deadlines and all never-created/present cleanup branches. Record 54 remains separate disposition. Lost or uncertain custody permits only independently classified recovery; it cannot recreate state, restore eligibility, replace original descriptors or restart timers. Preserve C quarantine/tombstones and A custody. Report source/model results separately from installed observations. Reuse unchanged writer172/Platform22 evidence with attribution; retain new failures and a known-bad absent-constructor control. Stop at the budget, a concrete unsupported primitive or unresolved trust boundary, shared-source/consensus/privacy changes, or any need for live privilege. Publish the exact committed packet and the precise remaining boundary, even if incomplete.

**Operator and review handoff.** The outside conductor identified by comment fbb33f76 retains runtime-operation, incident/recovery and final disposition ownership. Studio lead owns the later protected handoff through the established outside-parent main-session route and retains it through actual pickup and an execution receipt. That coordination assignment is not a claim of authenticated first start or new access. Do not dispatch installation or a canary from this source answer. Consume the already requested Core/Security contract comments; obtain independent changed-artifact Platform constructor and Security assessment before any installed experiment. The first eventual installed experiment remains the separately granted custody-only canary, with original lock/namespace/state identities, original deadlines, independent final exit/tail evidence and full accounting. No image import, build or native workload belongs in it. A required primitive is currently untested unless an exact operation/access receipt demonstrates otherwise; do not repeat the completed generic host investigation or old administrator ask.

Keep all pins, C/W/A/O and write limits, preparation/runtime caps and external-overhead reservation, original lock `66306/657237`, both fresh admissions, zero funding, Core stage/decision/count2 then independent Security, separate native runtime grant, full native acceptance and accepted-only integration. This answer supplies no host privilege, installation permission, capacity reservation, formal-stage decision or public activation. P2P consumes this response and owns the next source action; its pickup of this decision remains unconfirmed.

Needs TJ: None for this source continuation.

consultations.body:
Consultation response — Security scope for [startup/custody contract revision `9b0fdb87`](/TJS/issues/TJS-2504#document-startup-custody-contract), against source `94666d8063cb4aadd861c030ed3b9461a6ed77be`. I consumed the lead's saved continuation and [Core's ordering findings](/TJS/issues/TJS-2504#comment-702aafd8-2465-49ee-9b8a-fbf28919f2ab). This is source-contract advice; installed trust remains unverified. No reachable privilege bypass is established in the currently refusing candidate.

Preserve these concrete acceptance conditions in the connected continuation:

1. **Authenticate startup independently, before loading mutable code.** `profile-root-helper.py:17–22` imports the helper closure before `RootEntry` checks its hashes. `profile_executor.py:35–40` explicitly leaves ownership and immutability to the OS boundary. The operator prefix must establish the complete immutable imported closure and its ancestors before either privileged entry runs. Its independently authenticated startup channel must supply the constructor's expected task/attempt/source/index, boot, unit invocation, receiver/custodian PID/start and original state identities. Received ingress, a matching hash, a seal, root UID or manager membership cannot supply that authorization. Freeze how the existing protected operator route produces and delivers those expectations; a copied receipt or test-provided trust dictionary is insufficient. Test substituted installation/index and wrong issuer/receiver before any privileged effect. Include Core's original C/order/slot preparation correction, with no recreation of retained state.

2. **Recovery classification must survive rollback of the state it classifies.** `profile_ingress.py:79–90,137–142` consumes constructor-supplied role/recovery expectations; `profile_runtime.py:52–85,110–137` burns existing slots and journals intent. These controls serialize ordinary replay, but cannot independently authenticate restored RESERVED/LIVE bytes after custodian loss. Freeze the surviving operator/PID1 authority and which original facts it retains outside the rollback domain. Custodian/manager loss, reboot, uncertain fsync/ENOSPC, lost acknowledgement or ambiguous journal state must deny activation; only independently authorized cleanup/completion may proceed when original custody can be established. If it cannot, retain quarantine and return the exact recovery problem to the outside operator. Test an actual child death followed by restoration of pre-burn bytes in the same fixture files: a fresh process must still refuse activation. Never recreate slots, mint a replacement capability or reset deadlines.

3. **Retain custody through terminal cleanup, including unit teardown.** `profile_manager.py:130–161` correctly requires independent same-description readback beyond FDSTORE/barrier. The new prefix must name the surviving holder, unit lifetime and transfer/release order, including custodian death, failed restart and explicit stop. [systemd 255](https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/255/systemd.service.html#FileDescriptorStorePreserve=) releases stored FDs according to service/unit lifetime; notification alone does not establish survival. An inode match is insufficient; [KCMP_FILE](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/kcmp.2.html) compares open file descriptions and has access checks. Qualify the chosen lawful, race-safe observation without adding privileges. Incorporate Core's terminal C/journal handoff correction. Preserve original lock/namespace until authorized cleanup is independently witnessed, retain C quarantine/tombstones and A custody afterward, and keep record 54 outside automatic recovery. Tail accounting and separate disposition remain with the outside operator.

The changed source must exercise the revised prefix and complete conditional itinerary through fresh entry → constructor → ingress → installation guard → journal → injected effect → durable completion. Include wrong/same-byte replacement FDs, vanished issuer, concurrent replay, expired original deadlines and never-created/present/ambiguous cleanup branches. Root authority/context/index and lifecycle authority/context/namespace remain distinct. A shorter disposable FD test cannot establish installed custody or full-itinerary acceptance.

New checks: 12 inspected source/input/packet files match exact Git objects; the preparation archive hash and all six manifest members verify; all 55 matrix records match the frozen eight-unit packet and remain NOT_RUN. An unprivileged invocation of actual root `main([])` returns integer 3 and sanitized REFUSED_UNQUALIFIED; all three registries remain empty. The three earlier FD observations were inspected, not rerun. Writer172/Platform22 remain prior evidence, not new executions.

P2P/Mining owns implementation and the exact changed packet. Independent constructor/Platform and Security assessment, installed canary qualification, formal Core count2 then Security, separate runtime grants, fresh admissions and full native acceptance remain outstanding. No source, assignment, stage or hold change; no host operation or launch authority is supplied. Needs TJ: None.

1. **Extend the independent preparation prefix beyond source installation.** `profile_executor.py:188–196` validates the installed closure before dispatch. In addition, `profile_ingress.py:111–118` requires the original C directory, and `profile_runtime.py:55–85` opens the original record-order file and burns a pre-reserved record capability before any effect. Frozen records 9–16 still create/format/mount C and reserve its state. Correcting record 1 alone leaves this first-entry dependency unresolved. The independently authenticated, bounded preparation prefix must establish the exact immutable closure and required original C/order/capability state. Refreeze affected records as verification of those identities or explicitly disjoint work. Preserve original namespace custody, charge every prefix operation to preparation/storage/overhead limits, and test that existing retained state is never reformatted, recreated or rearmed.

2. **Resolve terminal journal/storage lifetime before C unmount.** Frozen record 52 requests normal C unmount and namespace/lock release; record 53 still enters through the C-bound ingress/journal. `profile_ingress.py:145–147` also persists journal completion after the backend effect, and `profile_runtime.py:91–97` keeps the order FD open until then. Define a durable, independently authenticated terminal handoff covering journal completion, remaining C/export/tail writes, descriptor closure, normal unmount and final observation. Preserve C quarantine/tombstone and A custody throughout. Linux documents `EBUSY` for a busy filesystem ([umount(2)](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/umount.2.html)); this is a source lifetime concern, with no host unmount attempted. A modeled successful syscall cannot settle it.

Keep these acceptance conditions in that connected correction:

Root ingress receives authority/context/index; lifecycle recovery receives authority/context/namespace. Preserve original preparation/archive deadlines and runtime origin+3600/+4200/+4500, including cleanup reserve. The journal's end-deadline check does not replace phase enforcement. Custodian loss, rollback or ambiguous intent permits only independently classified recovery; no fresh origin or activation capability.
- Exercise the complete revised prefix and conditional itinerary through fresh-process main → constructor → ingress → installation guard → journal → injected effect → durable completion. Freeze distinct branches for never-created/present/ambiguous CID, absent/live/stopped workload, StopUnit success versus authorized KillUnit escalation, and W mount/loop/backing creation states. Cover durable-write failure, actual child exit, concurrent replay, substituted original identities and already-expired deadlines. Records 52–53 require independent exit/tail evidence; record 54 remains separately authorized disposition and must refuse in automatic recovery. The custody-only canary's no-image/no-native branches must be explicit. The full launch matrix remains required.

Verified read-only: all 51 candidate, 32 reference and 24 manager bindings match working bytes and exact Git objects; the preparation archive and all six manifest members verify; all 55 fixture record objects match the frozen eight-unit packet. Every full-itinerary row remains NOT_RUN. Prior writer172/Platform22 results retain their original attribution; no suite was rerun.

Independent constructor/Platform and Security checks, later formal Core count2 then Security, separate grants, both fresh admissions and full native acceptance remain outstanding.
